selected_evidence.requirement: SSH key-based access for opsbot from node1 to node2
selected_evidence.summary: Generated keypair on node1, installed pubkey in node2 authorized_keys, and confirmed opsbot@node1 can SSH to opsbot@node2 (whoami=opsbot, hostname=node2) with BatchMode=yes (no password used)

selected_evidence.requirement: Key-based authentication required for opsbot on both systems

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
